name: LavaLending borrowable WETH/USDC.e wrapper LP priced from dust residual supply
summary: Lava listed a UniV3 wrapper LP as borrowable collateral priced by WrapperOracle at wrapper assets (including unclaimed fees) over live totalSupply. The attacker borrowed the LP out of the reserve and redeemed it, leaving dust supply, donated fees to inflate the per-share price, and borrowed every reserve's cash against the inflated aLP collateral.
notes: Reset: the configuration that made the LP reserve collateral (LTV 9000) and variable-borrowable, the last change the exploit needed; the oracle and wrapper beacon route are older, and the later LTV raise only changed exposure.

Gross depletion of third-party cash in the five reserves; the attacker's and helper's own deposits recovered in the tx are excluded. Other suppliers' 30.93 LP is valued at the pre-exploit WrapperOracle price, not the manipulated one.

A separate record (eip155:42161:0xcb1a2f5e) covers the March 2024 single-token fee-cap bug in a different wrapper; this October 2024 drain exploits the borrowable-LP supply reduction and is another incident.
